name: Journey Electronics Corp.
old_description: Journey Electronics is your trusted partner for printed circuit board fabrication and assembly, including both SMT and through-hole technologies. Proudly delivering reliable electronics manufacturing solutions since 1983.
about:
Journey Electronics Corp. was founded in 1983 in Monroe, Ohio, as a family-owned operation focused on printed circuit board fabrication and assembly. The company began as a small shop and has grown into a recognized Midwest electronics manufacturer.

The company provides surface mount (SMT) and through-hole PCB assembly, PCB fabrication through partners, first article and functional testing, automated optical inspection, wire harness and cable assembly, box build, and PCB design and layout services. It handles low- to mid-volume runs of 50 to 1,000-plus pieces, along with prototype and new product introduction builds, and offers redesign, modification, and rework for existing assemblies.

Journey Electronics serves industrial automation and control, test and measurement, consumer electronics, lighting and LED systems, automotive, industrial equipment, construction equipment, textile labeling, high-speed inkjet press manufacturing, and other OEMs. Past customers cited include NCR, Corning, 3M, NASA, and Kodak, and the company has built controls for welding systems, spectroscopy, moisture control, additive feeders, dimensional inspection, banking and ATM systems, conveyor management, heat transfer, touch sensing, and high-powered LED lighting.

The company emphasizes its IPC-A-610 and IPC-A-600 trained assembly processes, ANSI/ESD S20.20-2021 compliant facility, and RoHS-compliant manufacturing since 2006. As a family-owned business, it highlights personalized service, flexible turnkey or consignment manufacturing, competitive pricing, and consistent on-time delivery.
